the interaction between cholesterol and the surfactants can be studied using reversed‐phase thin layer chromatography.

the strength of interaction between cholesterol and surfactants can be quantitatively determined by RP‐TLC and the results obtained are useful to understand the mechanism of action of cholesterol‐lowering drugs and the effect of cholesterol on the biological activity of surfactants.
